title: Examination Documentation
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Record what you looked at as well as what you found, because a normal finding is only informative if the reader knows it was sought.
Record the effusion, the range in degrees, and the extensor mechanism on every knee, because all three change and all three matter.
Record laxity as a comparison with the other side, with an endpoint, and with the flexion angle the test was done at.
Record negatives explicitly where they matter.
Grade two laxity is not comparable with anything.
Record the second and the first can be revised.
